The stage goal permits different native semantics and does not itself remove manual demonstration behavior.

localRemaining.finding: The async tool wrapper catches Exception and records only after its try/except. asyncio.CancelledError bypasses that record. Mac act_and_verify dispatches native input directly, saves action_result, then awaits post-action verification. Cancellation in this window can leave an executed input with no ACC audit entry. A normal timeout returns an envelope and is a distinct path.
localRemaining.completion: Preserve cancellation while recording action-sent/uncertain outcome, then exercise cancellation after action_result is saved with post-action worker blocked and assert the actual audit row.
localRemaining.dependency: Local source fix and focused regression evidence. Parent followup edits are outside this baseline review.

The live ACC audit assertion inspects write_file success/refusal, not native recording, macro or action cancellation.

evidenceInterpretation: Actual Chinese injection is narrower than actual input-method switching.
Secure Event Input refusal is narrower than OS lock or TCC revocation.
The historical locked-capture capability receipt supports capture refusal and does not establish action-time input safety.
Bypass-mode App success and generic policy units leave normal approval deny/cancel evidence open.
An empty uncovered-name list supports heuristic inventory coverage and does not establish checkpoint/rollback behavior.
Generic audit/redaction tests and audited decorators leave real native success/failure/cancel log verification open.
Prior versioned application evidence remains valid for its bound slice and needs explicit reuse justification for a newer helper.
recommendedOrder: Close the concrete cancelled-action audit defect and verify the actual audit row.
Complete actual IME switching and normal approval/native audit/checkpoint roundtrips on the current host.
Resolve live/manual recording scope and complete the authorized functionality accordingly.
Collect user-mediated revoke/lock evidence, then remaining layout, catalog and selected-application candidate coverage.
Reconcile current bookkeeping and retain external resource gates with their exact dependencies.
